BM_Arena_ActiveProbe.name: Black Market Probe
BM_Arena_ActiveProbe.description: A cutting edge sensor enhancement suite built for arena combat. It amplifies a ‘Mech’s detection capabilities. Extends base sensor range and allows for the detection of units outside line of sight within the probe’s enhanced sensor range. Reduces the HUD disruption caused by hostile ECMs. Compatible with Active Probe hardpoints.

BM_Arena_ECM.name: Black Market Countermeasures
BM_Arena_ECM.description: This prototype electronic warfare suite shields the 'Mech from hostile sensors and homing missiles, serving as an effective defensive tool in arena combat. In counter mode, it suppresses sensors and disables hostile ECMs within its range. Compatible with ECM hardpoints

ClanDoubleHeatSink.name: Clan Double Heat Sink
ClanDoubleHeatSink.description: A double heat sink. More powerful but bulkier than standard heat sinks.

ClanECM.name: Clan ECM
ClanECM.description: An advanced suite of enhanced electronic countermeasures that, by default, shields friendly units within its disrupt range from hostile sensors and homing missiles. Hostiles within the disrupt range have their sensors further suppressed, and suffer accuracy penalties, against all units. Can be toggled into counter mode, which disables all hostile ECMs within its range. Compatible with ECM hardpoints.

MASC_MKI.name: MASC MK I
MASC_MKI.description: Myomer Accelerator Signal Circuitry, a device used to enhance the output of the myomer musculature that propels a BattleMech’s legs, resulting in short bursts of increased mobility and ground speed. Overuse risks structural damage in the legs. Compatible with Motive Upgrade Mk I hardpoints.
